source.title: Name-first original Dragonflight ore/herb completed-cast histogram search

notes: Open T0020/T0018/T0041/T0019/T0046 checked first. Found only previously indexed original Dragonflight prospect/mill samples (Ursallena, ar_rules, Jallfo, Bugy, Xenastro, Aary, superbondez, etc.) or reference guides. Did not reimport translations, PTR mirrors or copied study cohorts. None of the queried pages supplies independent rank-separated output-specific castsWithDrop, actual operation-level zero bins, refund-aware completed operations and 0/1/2+ histograms. Advanced to four distinct gear Looter sources only after open searches. Do not infer denominators from nominal ore/herbs, convert quantity to hits, or impute zero.
lookingFor: Source-original Dragonflight Draconium Ore, Serevite Ore, Khaz'gorite Ore and Prismatic Ore prospecting 0-N per-material completed-cast logs, and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage milling histograms with net-versus-gross refunds, ranks and specialized skill
whereLooked: Reddit r/woweconomy name search: Draconium Ore prospecting original result spreadsheet and per-prospect output ledger — indexed Bugy/Xenastro original cohorts only.
Reddit r/woweconomy name search: Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting results per gem and original 0-N output log — previously indexed 10h6ccx original 20-prospect zero-diamond cohort.
Reddit r/woweconomy name search: Bubble Poppy milling results pigment quantities — no independent finished-mill histogram.
Reddit r/woweconomy name search: Saxifrage milling 1000 pigments — Aary historical source previously indexed.
Blizzard US forums named Prismatic Ore prospecting 100 diamond results — no independent per-operation 0/1/2+ source.
Warcraft Wiki named Serevite Ore prospecting quality rank chance — reference facts, no per-cast samples.
GitHub public named Dragonflight Serevite Ore prospecting result CSV and SavedVariables — no original player completed-cast log discoverable.
Wowhead named Prismatic Ore comments / PTR language mirror — superbondez, TheChisel and Zuhla are previously indexed, duplicated across localization.
Wowhead named Illimited Diamond material page — Bugy original pooled 2000/100 row reference and neoslayyer original 150/1000 nominal ore reports already indexed.
Wowhead/Reddit original named Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage and Draconium Serevite ranking searches — no further independent sample.
